baseline.description: Selects SAFE, ProcVLM, RynnValue, or Robo-Dopamine and determines the runner, environment, checkpoint defaults, and raw-output contract.

scope.description: Selects the rollout partition. The web scope maps to --partition plus an optional --dataset-role: all, natural_observation, controlled_analysis, primary_natural, or reference_natural.

partition.description: Selects natural observations, controlled analysis, or all manifest records.

dataset_role.description: Further restricts selection to an exact manifest dataset_role such as primary_natural or reference_natural.

rollout_id.description: Selects an exact rollout ID; the command-line runner accepts this option repeatedly.

start_index.applies_to: all baseline runs; scope-relative for worker ranges
start_index.description: Starts positional selection after partition, dataset-role, and rollout-ID filters. Worker rows use the same scope-relative index space.

limit.description: Keeps at most N records after the preceding filters; leave empty to process the complete selected scope.

gpu.description: Sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. With explicit worker rows, each worker receives its one numeric GPU ID and duplicate IDs are allowed. --gpu 0,1 supplies IDs for automatic worker assignment when parallel workers are requested. A legacy single ProcVLM/Robo-Dopamine worker may still expose a comma-separated tensor-parallel GPU list.

memory_utilization.description: Targets the requested fraction of currently free GPU memory. The runner reads free and total memory immediately before the persistent vLLM worker and converts it to the total-memory value expected downstream. It is not a fraction of total memory, and utilization percentage is not a gate.

vllm_free_memory_fraction.description: Targets the requested fraction of currently free GPU memory. The runner converts this free-memory target to a vLLM total-memory fraction after measuring nvidia-smi free/total memory; GPU utilization is recorded only.

model_path.description: Overrides the configured local model checkpoint. SAFE uses its official handcrafted signals and does not use this option.

dtype.description: Sets the model and inference dtype.

tensor_parallel_size.description: Sets the vLLM/model tensor-parallel degree. Pair --gpu 0,1 with --tensor-parallel-size 2.

procvlm_window_size.description: Number of sampled images supplied in each temporal inference window. Larger windows add context and memory use.

procvlm_max_sampled_frames.description: Optional cap on frames sent to ProcVLM. If empty, the upstream 512-frame cap remains active.

procvlm_max_new_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens for each frame/window response; larger values increase time and KV-cache demand.

rynn_num_frames.description: Number of uniformly sampled frames used for each prefix value prediction. Zero/all-frame-per-prefix mode is disabled because variable-length prefixes can exhaust GPU memory.

rynn_num_steps.description: Deprecated compatibility option. The runner ignores this requested count and computes the upstream endpoint count from --rynn-evaluation-interval for each rollout.

rynn_batch_size.description: Prefix sub-samples per forward pass. Any positive value is accepted and forwarded to the official worker; it is independent of rollout worker parallelism and increasing it can improve throughput but increases peak GPU memory.

rynn_max_image_side.description: Caps the longer side of each frame before inference; lower values reduce memory and compute.

rynn_max_new_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens for the analysis text block; it does not change value-head sample count.

robot_description.description: Robot embodiment text included in RynnValue metadata.

camera_description.description: Camera viewpoint text included in RynnValue metadata.

robo_frame_interval.description: Samples every N source frames while retaining frame 0 and the final frame.

robo_batch_size.description: Number of sampled inputs per inference batch; lower it to reduce peak memory.

robo_eval_mode.description: Fused runs the official incremental, forward, and backward perspectives once per rollout and averages their native progress outputs. The other values retain the single-perspective compatibility modes.
robo_eval_mode.forwarded_as: --eval-mode fused; wrapper expands to --eval-modes incremental forward backward

goal_image.description: Goal/reference image for the official pipeline; the configured blank goal is used when omitted.

render_video.description: Enables optional baseline visualization video. It is accepted by SAFE and ProcVLM but not forwarded by their wrappers.

validate_environment.description: Imports core packages in the selected existing environment before workers start; it does not perform model inference.

dry_run.description: Validates selection and paths and records planned commands without loading a model or creating raw outputs.

continue_on_error.description: Continues later isolated rollouts after an ordinary worker failure. In worker mode, SAFE and RynnValue continue other rollout shards; persistent ProcVLM and Robo-Dopamine workers isolate ordinary per-rollout failures, while engine-fatal failures remain resumable.

manifest.description: Versioned LF3R JSONL manifest. The web UI supplies the current project manifest.

data_root.description: Root for relative media and CSV paths. The web UI always keeps this within the project.

output_dir.description: Parent directory for timestamped baseline output. The web UI chooses outputs/baselines/web_runs.

resume_run.description: Resumes an interrupted persistent run from its saved plan; web batch keeps the command-line resume capability outside the browser.

rynn_evaluation_interval.description: Target source-video frame interval. Before each rollout command, LF3R computes ceil((T-1)/K)+1 approximate endpoints and passes that count as the upstream --num_steps value; upstream still samples endpoints uniformly, so the realized spacing is approximate.
rynn_evaluation_interval.forwarded_as: per-rollout --num_steps N (computed by the LF3R runner)

end_index.applies_to: all baseline runs; exclusive worker-range end
end_index.description: Exclusive end of the selected rollout range, so [start,end) contains end-start positions. It is mutually exclusive with --limit. Explicit worker rows must fit inside this total range.

parallel_workers.description: Number of independent rollout workers. Each worker owns one scope-relative shard and processes that shard sequentially; ProcVLM and Robo-Dopamine initialize one independent persistent model engine per worker, SAFE runs per-rollout workers, and RynnValue keeps its temporal batch_size unchanged.

worker_spec.description: Explicit scope-relative right-open worker shard. Repeat it for each worker. Each row uses one numeric GPU ID; repeated GPU IDs are allowed, overlapping ranges are deduplicated in first-worker order, and gaps mark the aggregate run partial.

gpu.applies_to: OpenVLA natural rollout generator (selected task suite)
gpu.description: Single numeric CUDA device used by the selected-suite wrapper. The wrapper performs the memory-only gate; GPU utilization is logged but does not block.

task_start.applies_to: OpenVLA natural rollout generator (selected task suite)
task_start.description: First selected-suite LIBERO task index, inclusive. Both supported suites currently expose task indices 0 through 9.

task_end.applies_to: OpenVLA natural rollout generator (selected task suite)
task_end.description: Last selected-suite LIBERO task index, inclusive. It must be at least task-start and at most 9.

trials.applies_to: OpenVLA natural rollout generator (selected task suite)
trials.description: Episodes generated per selected task, from 1 through 50.

seed.applies_to: OpenVLA natural rollout generator (selected task suite)
seed.description: Non-negative evaluation seed used by the official evaluator.

run_note.applies_to: OpenVLA natural rollout generator (selected task suite)
run_note.description: Unique run note. The server creates a suite-specific timestamped prefix and refuses to overwrite an existing output directory. Spatial runs use lf3r-data-natural-libero-spatial-256-.

log_safe_features.default: true in the web UI; false for direct CLI unless supplied
log_safe_features.applies_to: OpenVLA natural rollout generator (selected task suite)
log_safe_features.description: Saves official OpenVLA hidden states and LF3R SAFE numeric sidecars for each generated episode. Disable to save only the normal video/CSV/log outputs.

task_suite.description: Selects the natural LIBERO suite. LIBERO-Spatial uses the existing Spatial checkpoint with native 256x256 simulator and replay frames while policy preprocessing remains 224x224; LIBERO-10 keeps the existing output root.
task_suite.forwarded_as: --task_suite_name=SUITE to the official evaluator; wrapper selects the suite output root

font_scale.description: Global root typography scale. It combines with the active page category scale and uses rem-based CSS.

review_font_scale.description: Review-only typography multiplier for queue, video controls, baseline cards, and annotation form.

analysis_font_scale.description: Analysis-only typography multiplier for filters, tables, charts, and job panels.

control_font_scale.description: Typography multiplier for controls and contextual help text.
